## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~2.1 GB, from [huggingface.co/Qwen](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/f74adce6aa16316c625447af059dbebe4983757c))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~2.1 GB, from [huggingface.co/Qwen](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/f74adce6aa16316c625447af059dbebe4983757c))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: 4bit (~1.7 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit -y` · 8bit (~3.3 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-8bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.9 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/qwen2.5-coder/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run qwen2.5-coder:3b
   ```

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct (4bit, needs ~1.7 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit/tree/1466650d4af1e954eee2cc26174c7c2f4fbf4b9b))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model lmstudio-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~3.3 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-8bit`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/Qwen](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct)
